name: exo-mailboxes-with-calendar-delegates
title: Exchange Online Mailboxes with Calendar Delegates
shortDescription: This script inventories calendar permissions across Exchange Online mailboxes and exports delegate identities, access rights, and sharing flags to CSV.
longDescription: Connects to Exchange Online using certificate-based app-only authentication, discovers the default calendar folder for each mailbox, and reports calendar permission entries while excluding the built-in Default and Anonymous entries. Writes a timestamped CSV report and execution log.
